What Batman Forever drew on this machine, built as a type 1 CRTC: one
line per frame kept, the frame's number since the command was typed and a
hash of the whole raster. Frames are taken at the monitor's retrace, every
25 of them, and 34000 are played in all.

This record grades nothing. No capture of this demo on a real machine of this
type has been set beside it, so it says only what this machine drew on
the day it was taken. A line that moves is a change to look at: the tier writes the
frames that moved as pictures beside this file.

The disc played is batman-forever.dsk, 858368 bytes hashing to 1e13a1ac5f12e332, which
tools/fetch-discs.sh pins: a release other than that one is a record of
its own rather than a machine that has moved. It is started from drive B
with |b:run"disc, and a key is pressed at frame 501.
